privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Armonia is designed to work locally in the browser. This page summarizes what data is handled and where it stays.
privacy.localFilesBody: When you open a .md or .txt file, its content is read by the browser only to generate the preview, player, and print view. The app does not upload the file to a server.
privacy.noBackendBody: Armonia currently does not use a backend to store songs, accounts, or history. Songs are processed in memory during the current session.
privacy.storageBody: The app may use localStorage to remember technical preferences such as language and theme. These values stay in your browser.
privacy.exportBody: When you save a .md file or generate a PDF, the content is produced locally by the browser. You decide where to store or share it.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Bootstrap and icons may be loaded as app assets or from CDNs configured in the project. Music links in song metadata are opened only when you select them.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Manage the basic app preferences stored on this device.
preferences.storageNote: Changes are saved locally in this browser.
preferences.languageDescription: Choose the language used by the app interface.
preferences.themeDescription: Choose the visual theme used across the app.
preferences.notationGroupDescription: Choose how chords are displayed when a song is opened.
preferences.preferredNotationDescription: Choose the notation you normally want to use.
preferences.notationPriorityDescription: Choose whether song metadata or your preference should win when both are available.
preferences.playerGroupDescription: Set the default player behavior for rehearsals and reading.
preferences.chordDisplayDescription: Choose the default amount of chord detail shown in the player.
preferences.chordColorDescription: Choose the color used to highlight chords in previews.
preferences.wordSplitFillDescription: Choose what to insert when dense chords force a word to split.
preferences.autoScrollDescription: Choose the default scroll duration for a song.
preferences.textSizeDescription: Choose the default text size adjustment in the player.
preferences.metadataDescription: Show title details such as key, tempo, capo, and links in the player.
